question: On 7 March 2025, Govind Ballabh Pant's death anniversary, tributes were paid for his leadership in India's early post-independence years. Which state did he serve as its first Chief Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Govind Ballabh Pant was the **first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**, serving from 26 January 1950 to 27 December 1954.
 
• Uttar Pradesh, formerly known as the United Provinces, was reorganized and renamed on 26 January 1950, becoming the largest state in India.
 
• Pant was known for his pioneering role in **strengthening India's federal structure** and advocating for land refor
